Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10th - June 20th, 2024

Essential Items:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen
- Hiking gear
- Casual outfits
- Camera
- Travel documents

- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap
- Flip flops/sandals
- Light rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkeling gear (optional, can be rented)
- Insect repellent
- After-sun lotion

- Waterproof phone case
- Power bank/charger
- Travel adapter if needed
